Kindly guide us. 3868 views Q. Ibn Arabi said, "العبد رب و الرب عبد" or "al-`abd-u rabb-un wa-r-rabb-u `abd-un" (the slave is the lord and the lord is the slave)." Sufis claim that such statements were always considered to be the most elevated exposition of mystical thought in Islam, and therefore unsuitable for the untrained mind. Ibn Arabi has also said, "الرب رب في التنزل والعبد عبد في الترقى" or "ar-rabb-u rabb-un f? t-tanazzul-i wa-l-`abd-u `abd-un f? t-taraqq?" (The lord is a lord in his descent [to his creations] and a slave is a slave in rising). in Fusoos Al-Hikam" and "Al-Ahkaam. answer: Miscellaneous >> Tasawwuf Question ID: 36521 Country: Pakistan Title: Looking for Sheikh for bait in Lahore Pakistan Question: I was to do bait with a person who can allow me to spend some time with him, live with him for few days and can give me few minutes individually once a week. But here in Lahore, Pakistan I have not found such person up to now. At Jamia Ashrafia we have Hadhrat Sufi Server sahib but he has huge number of his followers and he has almost no time for a person like me. Similar case we some other people. Can you please help me in finding the right person for me? Answer ID: 36521 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 307/115/L=1433) In order to do baiah you should look for any Sheikh and see whether the states of those who are attached to him are improving or not. Also, shall you get benefit if you do baiah on his hand? There is no need to look for other things. Leave other things on Sheikh. If Sheikh observes that his murid is sincere he will automatically bring the murid near to him. These things are not to be discussed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
